data.name: Alvian
data.gender_notes: Alvian is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic name 'Al-Wahhab', meaning 'the abundant one'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to possess great power and strength. The name Alvian carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Alvian usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and power of Allah and the faith and determination of the one who bears this name.
data.etymology: Alvian belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alvian total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
